founderRule: A distance session reaches its target only when the distance was actually covered. A measured 15.52 km does not by itself show that 16 km were run. Executed distance is never invented to offset GPS error. An explicit correction or confirmation is allowed when there is reasonable evidence of a measurement failure, and the originally recorded value is preserved. Absolute sensor precision is never demanded. A technical tolerance never becomes a fictitious sporting completion. (Founder, 2026-11-13, via SSCTR_DECISION_REQUEST_RWS_R3A.md; recorded as given.)

items.question: Separate measured distance, declared distance, source reliability and target met. Remove the automatic GPS >= 0.97 completion. Rule the bases on which a continuous distance target is met, and the statuses otherwise.
items.ruling: APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS (the author's proposal, with seven changes listed in changedFromProposal)
items.category: b on a (new fact model and bases over r3 C3, C5 and the tied 0.91; the Founder rule as given)
items.value: values.runFacts, values.completion.continuous, values.historyReference, values.statuses, values.exposure.X-2.counting, values.textRequirements.afterRun
items.summary: Each run keeps four separate facts. (1) Measured distance: immutable, with its source and quality. (2) Declared distance: the athlete's own figure, with a reason when it corrects a measurement. (3) Source reliability: OK, UNKNOWN or POOR, set by the device or by the athlete's failure reason. (4) Target met: yes or no, with its basis. A continuous distance target is met on exactly three bases. MEASURED: a usable measurement (track count, measured course, treadmill display, or GPS/device not POOR) is at or above the target, and the athlete has not declared less. CONFIRMED_CORRECTION: a measurement exists below the target (or is device-flagged POOR); the athlete declares at least the target with a listed measurement-failure reason (or the device's own POOR flag); the measurement is recorded as POOR, its original value is preserved, and it is at least 0.91 x target. This is the lowest tier. DECLARED: no measurement exists and the athlete explicitly declares at least the target. This is also the lowest tier. Every other case is not met. A usable measurement below target with no answer is PARTIAL with one ASK offering the stop reasons and the correction. A declaration of at least the target without a listed reason against a usable shorter measurement is UNKNOWN (MEASUREMENT_CONFLICT) with an ASK. A declaration with a reason but a measurement below 0.91 x target is UNKNOWN with an ASK offering a measurement of the missing part. A device-flagged POOR measurement with no declaration is UNKNOWN. A declaration below target is PARTIAL whatever the measurement says. No measurement and no declaration is UNKNOWN. The automatic 0.97 is removed: no tolerance ever turns a shorter measurement into a met target. Repetitions are unchanged: the lap decides (r2 N7, r3 C3).

kindByPart.fourFactSeparation: TECHNICAL_DATA_REQUIREMENT (required by the Founder rule; owned jointly with Data/G03)
kindByPart.MEASURED basis: PRODUCT_RULE_AS_GIVEN (Founder: distance actually covered, no absolute precision demanded); sporting-neutral
kindByPart.CONFIRMED_CORRECTION basis: PRODUCT_RULE_AS_GIVEN (Founder allows correction on reasonable evidence of failure) bounded by a CONSERVATIVE_HEURISTIC (the 0.91 floor, tied to SRC-RWS-01)
kindByPart.failureReasonList: TECHNICAL_DATA_REQUIREMENT (measurement failure modes); obstructed sky is tied to SRC-RWS-01 (urban and forest under-reading)
kindByPart.DECLARED basis: PRODUCT_RULE_AS_GIVEN (r3 MANUAL tier, kept); lowest tier because of SRC-RWS-08
kindByPart.X-2 counting exception: CONSERVATIVE_HEURISTIC (a shortfall within documented device error is not evidence that the format misfits)

changedFromProposal: The 0.91 floor bounds what a declaration alone can bridge. It does not bound measurement failures. 9% is the largest under-reading documented for a functioning watch (SRC-RWS-01); a device restart or a long tunnel can lose more than that. So a larger shortfall stays UNKNOWN until the athlete adds a measurement of the missing part (a second recording file, a track lap count, a measured course). The segments are then summed as a measured distance, and the run classifies as MEASURED.

The reason list is closed: SIGNAL_LOSS, OBSTRUCTED_SKY (tunnel, tall buildings, dense tree cover), AUTO_PAUSE, DEVICE_RESTART. Tree cover is added because SRC-RWS-01 documents under-reading in forest. Product may word these reasons but may not add any without SSCTR re-review.

A device-flagged POOR measurement counts as the failure evidence. A declaration of at least the target then follows CONFIRMED_CORRECTION, with the same 0.91 floor. With no declaration, it stays UNKNOWN (r3).

A declaration below the target is PARTIAL even when the measurement is at or above it. The athlete's account of a shortfall is never overridden by a device that can over-read (SRC-RWS-01 track; SRC-RWS3-01).

Consequential change to X-2: a PARTIAL that rests only on a usable measurement of at least 0.91 x target, with no stop and no answer confirming a shortfall, neither counts nor resets X-2. Without this, removing the 0.97 would let two device under-readings pause a class for 28 days.
Consequential change to history: a run's history reference distance is the smaller of its usable facts (values.historyReference). A correction never raises a run's history above its measurement.
Quality UNKNOWN (for example an imported workout with no quality flag) is treated as usable, not as POOR. POOR needs a device flag or an athlete failure reason.
conditions: The measured value is immutable. A correction adds a declared fact with its reason and time; it never edits or deletes the measured distance, source or quality. The engine's actual.distanceKm stays the measured value. Declared and corrected values travel in separate fields, and actual.completed stays coherent with the status (r3).
The classification runs after the run. The live target is never shortened, and a run is never shown as met early (r3). The athlete is never prompted to run extra so that a device matches.

The ASK after a usable measurement below target is one non-blocking question. It offers: a stop with its reason (then STOPPED, r3 C4 routes); 'I covered the distance; the measurement failed' with the closed reason list (then reclassified under values.completion.continuous); and 'I ran less, without stopping' (stays PARTIAL). With no answer it stays PARTIAL and is never read as SYMPTOM (r3 C5).

A CONFIRMED_CORRECTION or DECLARED distance never reaches a calibration or estimate consumer as a measured distance. How the V1RC input marks it (excluded, or MANUAL, which V1RC already reduces by two tiers) is for Engineering/QRE under the frozen V1RC rules; this record does not amend V1RC. r3 S3 is unchanged: GPS POOR is excluded, so corrected runs are excluded; DECLARED runs with entered minutes and distance remain a slow-only source.
Tiers never change progression credit (r3). DISTANCE on any basis credits as completed; PARTIAL and UNKNOWN hold the step (r3 C5).
A later answer or source correction reclassifies the run under the existing provenance rules of the record (first-recorded facts preserved).
items.rationale: r3 met a run automatically when GPS read at least 0.97 x target. The Founder rejects that because it is a technical tolerance standing in for a sporting fact: a watch reading 15.52 km does not show 16 km were covered, and watches err in both directions (under-reading up to 9% off-track and over-reading on the track, SRC-RWS-01; mostly over-reading on certified courses, SRC-RWS3-01). Neither a shortfall nor a sufficient reading is ground truth. The honest model therefore keeps what was measured, what the athlete declares, and how reliable the source was, and states on which basis the target was met. A usable measurement at or above target is accepted without demanding precision. Below target, only the athlete can say whether the distance was covered, and the Founder requires a reasonable failure cause. The 0.91 floor keeps a declaration within the error documented for a functioning device. Beyond that, the record needs a measurement of what was lost, not a larger declaration. A declaration with no device is accepted at the lowest tier, because single-run self-report is accurate on average but wide individually (SRC-RWS-08). The X-2 exception keeps device error from being read as format misfit, which would be the mirror of the fictitious completion the Founder forbids.
items.evidenceStatusScope: SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITS that single wrist-GNSS readings err in both directions by up to about 9% (SRC-RWS-01, SRC-RWS-02, SRC-RWS3-01), which supports the fact separation and the 0.91 bound as a description of device error. Using 0.91 as a bound on declarations is a heuristic, not a validated threshold. No study validates athlete correction behaviour (PLAUSIBLE_BUT_UNCERTAIN), which is why corrections are lowest tier and bounded.
items.confidenceReason: The device evidence is single-participant (SRC-RWS-01), from an older device generation (SRC-RWS3-01) or from track runs (SRC-RWS-02). The fact model itself is structural and follows the Founder rule directly (moderate confidence for that part only).
items.applicabilityLimits: Continuous EASY and LONG distance targets on roads, tracks, measured courses and treadmills. Trail stays TIME-recommended (r2 G.4). Repetitions are unchanged.

items.amends: RWS3-C1 CT-3 and RWS3-C2 (L30 and the comparable long run's history sources)
items.question: Make CT-3 (D <= 1.10 x the longest run of the last 30 days) proportional to history and data availability: (i) classify it; (ii) its history sources; (iii) confirm that failing it only changes the expression; (iv) whether EXPERIENCED athletes may use a longer window when the 30-day window is empty for a recorded reason.
items.ruling: (i) APPROVE: classified as a conservative expression heuristic. (ii) APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS (sources and the reference-distance rule; three changes from the proposal). (iii) CONFIRMED, with one precision. (iv) NOT ADOPTED: the window stays 30 days for every athlete, and the record abstains on any longer window.
items.category: (i) a (r3 already called 1.10 an outer bound); (ii) b; (iii) a; (iv) c

i_classification.ruling: CT-3 is an expression bound. It is not a safe threshold, not a dose rule and not a progression rule. It keeps a native distance target, which has no time ceiling, inside the reference category of Frandsen 2025 (single sessions up to 10% above the longest run of the previous 30 days). Frandsen is observational, and in its sensitivity analysis even 1-10% increases were associated with a higher rate. So 1.10 is the outer edge of the reference group, never evidence that a 10% increase is safe. The engine's own minute progression is not judged here (r3 observation, kept as a trigger).

ii_sources.kind: TECHNICAL_DATA_REQUIREMENT with a CONSERVATIVE_HEURISTIC (the reference-distance rule)
ii_sources.ruling: L30 is the largest history reference distance (values.historyReference) among executed runs of any family and any status, races included, dated within the last 30 days. Eligible sources are the engine ledger, HealthKit-imported workouts, manual entries, and an intake declaration of one recent run that carries a distance and a run date. The same run counts once: a ledger entry and an import of the same run merge their facts. The reference distance follows one rule. With a usable measurement only, it is the measured value. With a declaration only (no device), it is the declared value. With both, it is the smaller of the two, whatever the measurement's quality. With only a device-POOR measurement, there is none. Never used: undated declarations, weekly totals, and minutes-only figures (the current intake's recent.longestRunMinutes). Minutes are never converted to kilometres.
changedFromProposal: The proposal says a DECLARED distance counts only up to its measured value, which would give a no-device declaration nothing. Yet it accepts an intake declaration at face value. The two are the same kind of fact, so this record applies one rule: where no measurement of the run exists, the declaration is the reference; where a measurement exists, the smaller value is. A declaration never raises a measured run's reference.

An intake declaration needs a distance and a run date. The current intake stores minutes only, dated at the intake day, so today it contributes nothing to L30. Adding the field is a Product/Data choice; the handoff states no new intake inputs.
The same reference-distance rule applies wherever C2 reads a run's distance as history (the comparable long run and its S2 pace), so that L30 and C2 cannot disagree on one run.
ii_sources.rationale: CT-3 governs only how a dose is expressed, so its sources should be the best fact the record holds of each run, not only device data. The dose itself already comes from self-reported intake history (r6-intake). Excluding self-report from an expression bound would be stricter than the dose it expresses. The bound also rarely decides alone. CT-1 caps D at the planning minutes at the athlete's own slow pace. For LONG, C2 already requires an executed run within 28 days of nearly the same minutes, whose pace (S2) enters P_size. That keeps D at or below about M/(M-5) times that run's distance, below 1.10 for M of 55 min or more. P1 requires recorded easy runs within 28 days. A generous source therefore enables a distance expression only within minutes the engine has already prescribed. The smaller-value rule keeps a correction from inflating history (SRC-RWS-08).
ii_sources.evidenceStatus: PLAUSIBLE_BUT_UNCERTAIN for the accuracy of declared references (SRC-RWS-08); acceptable as an explicitly reversible limited rule because the bound controls expression only and is dominated by CT-1, C2 and P1

iii_effect.ruling: CONFIRMED. CT-3 never changes the planning minutes M, the family, the ladder step, the engine's credit or any load sum (r2 G.1, r3 G.2). It never blocks, cancels or shortens a session. One precision: CT-3 can select a smaller native D, provided CT-2's dose-parity floor (0.9 x M at P_typ) still holds. If no D passes CT-1 to CT-3, the session is the TIME expression of the same dose (NO_DISTANCE_WITHIN_CONTINUOUS_ENVELOPE). An unknown L30 also gives TIME (DISTANCE_HISTORY_UNKNOWN).
iii_effect.evidenceStatus: WELL_SUPPORTED (structural; read from r3 values.continuous and r2 G.1)

iv_longerWindow.ruling: NOT ADOPTED. The window stays 30 days for every experience level, whatever the recorded reason for the gap.
iv_longerWindow.rationale: (1) No evidence: Frandsen's reference is defined on the previous 30 days, and no source supports a longer reference after a gap. (2) Inert: P1 needs 3 qualifying easy runs within 28 days, and a LONG distance target needs a comparable executed run within 28 days (C2). With an empty 30-day window, both fail first, so a longer L30 window would enable no session. (3) A recorded reason (taper, travel) explains the gap but does not restore recent distance exposure. (4) The cost is the TIME expression only, and the window refills from the first recorded runs after the gap. Mode and phase rules (RESTART, RETURN, POST_EVENT) stay with the engine and V1RC and are not changed.
iv_longerWindow.confidence: MODERATE (that the extension would be inert)

LONG.comparableLongRun: an executed run in the record (engine ledger or HealthKit import) dated within the last 28 days, with actual minutes >= M - 5 and a values.historyReference. A CONFIRMED_CORRECTION run qualifies by its minutes, with its measured distance. A device-POOR run with no declaration does not qualify. An intake declaration never qualifies (it is not an executed run in the record; the first LONG of a plan is TIME, r3 C2). Otherwise TIME (LONG_HISTORY_NOT_COMPARABLE).

statuses.PARTIAL: known execution below target with no stop declared: a usable measurement below target with no declaration, or a declaration below target. The step holds; the existing PARTIAL_SESSION review applies; one non-blocking ASK (values.completion.continuous.notMet). A stop answer makes it STOPPED; a correction answer reclassifies it; no answer leaves it PARTIAL, never read as SYMPTOM.
statuses.UNKNOWN: no measurement and no declaration; a device-POOR measurement with no declaration; or MEASUREMENT_CONFLICT (a declaration >= target without a listed reason against a usable shorter measurement, or with a reason but measured < 0.91 x target). Not adverse; no symptom read; not counted by X-2; the step holds; correctable later through the record's correction path.

exposure.X-2.counting: r3 unchanged (a TIME session of the class executed without a stop resets; HEAT, HILLY, TRAIL or WIND_STRONG sessions, TREADMILL sessions and UNKNOWN sessions neither count nor reset), plus: a PARTIAL that rests only on a usable measurement >= 0.91 x target, with no stop and no athlete answer confirming a shortfall, neither counts nor resets. An answer confirming the shortfall makes it a counted PARTIAL.

the original measured distance is always shown next to any declared correction

aeReview.1_adequate: The plan and dose are untouched. Only completion classification and an expression bound change.
aeReview.2_materialFact: The Founder rule, plus documented two-directional device error (SRC-RWS-01, SRC-RWS3-01).
aeReview.3_keepDefensible: Keeping r3's automatic 0.97 is not defensible under the Founder rule: it turns a tolerance into a completion.
aeReview.4_changeNecessary: Yes for A1 (the Founder rule). For A2, only clarification of sources and classification; the bound itself is kept.
aeReview.5_smallest: Remove the automatic tolerance; keep the tied 0.91 for declarations only; keep 30 days and 1.10; add one history rule and one X-2 exception.
aeReview.6_smallerInsufficient: Without the X-2 exception, device under-reading would pause distance targets. Without the history rule, corrections could inflate L30. Without the 0.91 bound, declarations would be unbounded against a good measurement.
aeReview.7_priority: No Run or Strength priority is involved.
aeReview.8_evidence: SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITS for device error. The 0.91 bound and the CT-3 bound are heuristics. Declared-reference accuracy is PLAUSIBLE_BUT_UNCERTAIN, accepted only because CT-3 does not control dose.
aeReview.9_uncertainty: Correction behaviour, the share of runs that become PARTIAL or UNKNOWN, and the accuracy of declarations are unmeasured.
aeReview.10_askHoldClinical: ASK for conflicts and shortfalls; HOLD of the step on PARTIAL and UNKNOWN (r3). No clinical item: STOPPED SYMPTOM routes are unchanged.

abstentions: Any L30 window longer than 30 days, for any experience level or recorded reason (A2 iv): no evidence, and inert under P1 and C2.
Any numeric GPS quality metric that sets POOR: device flag or athlete reason only (Data owns the semantics).
Any tolerance under which a measurement below target counts as met (A1): withdrawn under the Founder rule.
A GPS tolerance for single repetitions (r3, unchanged).

escalations.item: Consequences of A1. A watch reading slightly short is no longer met without the athlete's answer and a listed cause. Shortfalls beyond 9% cannot be bridged by a declaration alone; they need a measurement of the missing part, or they stay UNKNOWN with the step held. A no-device declaration still meets the target at the lowest tier (r3 kept): this rests on the athlete's explicit word, recorded as such, never on missing data. Founder to confirm that this stays the intent; it is not a blocker.

Update handoff sections 3-5: remove 0.97; the four facts and three bases; the notMet table; the closed reason list; the history-reference rule; L30 sources; the X-2 exception; CT-3 classification and effect; superseded r3 worked examples.

The ASK flows (one combined question after a shortfall; the conflict ask; the add-a-measurement path); wording of the four reasons; showing the original measurement next to a correction; neutral statuses.

The four-fact schema and immutability; quality states OK, UNKNOWN and POOR; segment summation; dedup of ledger and imports; history reference. Whether to add a dated single-run distance to the intake (none exists today; the handoff says no new intake inputs).

Deterministic classification per the notMet table; the X-2 counting exception; actual.distanceKm stays measured; corrected and declared distances never reach V1RC as measured (V1RC unchanged); the L30 source union and dedup; the S2 lower-bound case.
No new clinical item. STOPPED SYMPTOM routes are unchanged (r3 C4).
